name: dubai-wealth-index
description: Dubai real estate data from Dubai Wealth Index: compare property sale prices, rents and gross rental yields using Dubai Land Department transactions and Ejari rental contracts. Research apartment buildings, areas and villa communities with source links, data dates and evidence counts.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about Dubai property prices, rents and rental yields using registered Dubai Land Department sales and Ejari rental contracts. Dubai Wealth Index (DWI) helps buyers, investors, tenants and property professionals compare buildings, research areas and check property claims with dated, sourced evidence.

Look up a building by its registered or marketing name. Compare two to four buildings on the same bedroom type. Find buildings meeting your price, gross yield and evidence thresholds. Research villa communities, inspect transactions behind the figures, or review your saved buildings and what changed between data editions.

Each quoted figure comes with its source, data date and evidence count. Distinguish building-specific rents from pooled evidence, gross yields from returns after costs, and registered transactions from modelled short-term rental scenarios. Missing figures stay unavailable rather than becoming estimates.

Dubai only. Figures describe registered transactions, not live listings or individual-unit valuations. Short-term rental figures use Airbnb asking rates and stated model assumptions. Villa figures are community-level. The plugin cannot book viewings, contact agents or give investment, mortgage, tax or legal advice. Tools are read-only. A Dubai Wealth Index account is required to connect; saved-building access depends on the permissions granted.
capabilities: Building prices, rents and gross yields
Full building reports with growth evidence
Check a yield claim against registered records
Your saved buildings and what changed
defaultPrompt: What does a 1-bedroom in Vera Tower, Business Bay rent for and yield?
Which Dubai Marina buildings have the highest gross rental yields?
An agent says Vera Tower yields 9%. What do registered records support?
